name: Karen Macaulay
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Currently Accepting New Referrals “Holding the Space” refers to being fully present in the here and now. I work from a trauma-informed and systemic framework and bring highly developed counselling skills to my practice. I support families experiencing a wide range of concerns, including trauma, grief and loss, often arising from separation, divorce, and blended family dynamics.

name: Cora Popa
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: Focusing on general population (children, tenagers and adults), I am commited to inspire people to acheve their wellbeing goals
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Shuwana Shiraze
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Welcome to a space where you are invited to explore the deeper currents of your life and relationships. My approach is client-centered and trauma-informed, rooted in Relational Gestalt psychotherapy. I apply an integrative method informed by Emotionally-Focused Therapy, somatic practices, Depth Inquiry-EMDR, psychodynamic exploration, and non-dual wisdom. I also incorporate parts work and Relational Life Therapy to help you understand and harmonize the different aspects of yourself and your relationships. In our work, we honor the wisdom of the body and the intelligence of emotions, exploring how different parts of you interact and impact your relationships.

name: Michelle van Kampen
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Grounded in Gestalt psychotherapy and Polyvagal theory, Michelle offers holistic, trauma-informed therapy in Melbourne, and online for interstate clients. With over eight years’ experience in both community and private practice, she specialises in working with trauma and victim survivors, including those affected by family violence, sexual assault, and crime. Her background includes roles as a trauma counsellor, crisis clinician for at-risk youth, NDIS, and provider for the Victims of Crime Financial Assistance Scheme (FAS), formerly VOCAT. She consults regularly with international trauma specialists to maintain a reflective, embodied, and best-practice approach. She also provides supervision for professionals seeking to deepen their trauma-informed practice.

name: Jo Pioro
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I am a Psychotherapist working with people who have a range of mental health symptoms including a range of complexities and multiple diagnosis. I am a specialist Trauma Psychotherapist and can apply a range of evidenced based trauma treatment modalities. I prefer to work with CBT Psychotherapy and EMDR Psychotherapy and I am an Accredited EMDR Consultant with the Australia EMDR Association (EMDRAA).

name: Alex Cloumassis
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: I work in different ways with different people. I believe that distressed humans are not disordered or diseased, but are usually responding normally to abnormal or harmful environments or events. I believe in compassion and understanding over diagnosis.
specialties: Posttraumatic stress disorder, Trauma recovery, Somatic psychotherapy

name: Willem (Bill) Van Schie
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Clinical)
description: Director - Abundant Life Counselling Director - Mt Evelyn Counselling

name: Geoffrey Phipps
title: Counsellor/Psychotherapist (PACFA Certified Practising)
description: We aim to provide our clients with the assistance they need to manage life’s ups and downs as they make their way through the challenges and circumstances we all experience. We want to help our clients to achieve psychological wellbeing, maintain healthy relationships and lead fulfilling, productive lives. We use a non-judgemental, compassionate and client centred approach to provide confidential counselling regardless of gender, religion, race, cultural heritage, sexual orientation or economic circumstance.
